Geo Sessions 2026: From Data Collection to Operational Intelligence

2026-09-12 GIM International / NV5 Geo Sessions 2026, NV5, geospatial, remote sensing, lidar, SAR, spectral imagery, GeoAI, digital twins, operational intelligence, webinar
Read the source article

Quick summary

NV5's Geo Sessions 2026 virtual event highlights a fundamental shift in the geospatial industry: the challenge is no longer collecting data but turning it into operational intelligence, with AI connecting multiple remote sensing technologies into seamless decision-support workflows.

Key takeaways

  • NV5's Geo Sessions 2026 is a global virtual event focused on the practical application of geospatial technologies, attracting several thousand registrants from 100+ countries
  • The industry has "largely solved the collection problem" — commercial satellites, drones, and airborne sensors generate unprecedented amounts of data
  • The real challenge is now helping decision makers understand what matters and what action they should take
  • The event features dedicated sessions on SAR, spectral imaging, lidar, and new for 2026, GeoAI
  • AI is accelerating the evolution by creating new opportunities to connect geospatial data, automate workflows, and surface insights that previously required significant manual effort
  • Over 20 international speakers with live panel discussions and audience Q&A
  • The event is free to attend with sessions available on demand afterwards
